title: Dashboard view architecture: Cloud=overview, Frontier=default, Focus=drill-in
summary: Decision (2026-06-10): the graph dashboard became unreadable at ~290 nodes because 98% are inert (done/canceled/notes) yet rendered at full weight with ~630 edges. New view architecture: Flow view is replaced by a Frontier view that renders only active tasks + 1-hop neighbors + important ancestors, where importance = blocking edges always, context edges by weight (task.context_weights). Context nodes/edges DO render inside the frontier (small set, no toggle needed). Cloud (force) stays as the whole-graph overview. New Focus view shows one node's ancestry+descendants, opened via a Focus button in the detail sidebar from either view. Principle carried to the API later: never ship the whole graph; ship weight-guided frontier + context (get_full_graph digest + archival sweep are backlog).
